author: igrandtheftauto
text:
Rockstar has revealed some of the extreme lengths people have gone to in order to obtain information about GTA 6.

The company says a hacking group attempted to blackmail them within the last few weeks, while drones have previously been used to photograph inside its offices - forcing Rockstar to install privacy film on the windows!

The details emerged during the first day of Rockstar's employment tribunal in Glasgow (full details below).
